name: esg-commitment-audit
description: Audit ESG and climate commitments with source-linked evidence through the ICS hosted API.

interface.shortDescription: Audit ESG and climate commitments with source evidence
interface.longDescription: A dedicated sustainability plugin for written ESG and climate commitments. It extracts targets and management details, traces findings to page or paragraph evidence, and tests observability, enforceability, and revisability under the ICS CRV structure. The plugin is free; hosted audits require a matching ESG API key.
defaultPrompt: Use $esg-commitment-audit to audit this ESG report and show traceable commitment gaps.
